summary: Iteration 9 covered the security fixes, Onboarding, Rubrica, Foto 3D, Registra and regressions. Backend: 38/38 pytest pass. Two tests from older iterations were updated to the new behaviour: the exp:// join tests now use an *.emergentagent.com host, and the CDN reachability test was replaced by a self-hosted /api/lib test. New file test_security.py covers: lib 404s, CSP header, the join allowlist (exp://evil.com, exps://evil.com, emergentagent.com.evil.com, https://evil, javascript:, and a same-host suffix trick all fall back to frontend://), allowed Emergent hosts, same-host https, and CORS sending no credentials and not reflecting the origin. Frontend: several Playwright runs at 375x667 using two pages with fake media. ONBOARDING passes: fresh / goes to /welcome, the 3 steps advance with Avanti, 'Inizia' goes Home, it does not show again after reload, Salta works from a fresh browser, and home-intro-button reopens it. RUBRICA passes: empty-name and bad-code errors, digits-only input capped at 6, add, delete, persistence after reload, contacts-call opens /sender?code=X and auto-calls, sender-contact chips show the name and recent codes leave out saved contacts, history shows the contact name after saving, and history-save-contact opens /contacts?code=X with the code prefilled. SECURITY passes: the stage loads the self-hosted libs, viewer-new-code-button gives a different 6-digit code, the call connects, and decline works. Call flooding regenerates the code after more than 5 calls in 60s, BUT the 'Troppe chiamate...' warning is overwritten at once by 'In attesa di chiamata.', so the user never sees it. FOTO 3D passes: demo, in-call and fullscreen each download VR180-foto-*_SBS.jpg and show 'Foto 3D pronta'. REGISTRA passes on viewer, sender and fullscreen: label shows 'Ferma 00:0X', stop downloads VR180-chiamata-*.mp4 (Chromium supports video/mp4, so the file is .mp4 rather than .webm; about 630KB for 3s), status shows 'Registrazione salvata', and hanging up while recording saves the file on both sides. On the viewer, though, the confirmation is hidden after hangup. Regressions pass: chat both ways, quick reply toast, reactions, stats, decline. No pageerrors.

ui_bugs.issue: stage.html rigeneraCodice() creates a new peer, and its 'open' handler calls stato('In attesa di chiamata.'). This overwrites 'Troppe chiamate in poco tempo: per sicurezza ho creato un nuovo codice.' within about 1s, so the user sees the code change with no reason given. Measured: after the 6th call, viewer-status = 'In attesa di chiamata.' and the code had changed. Reference: /app/backend/stage.html:310, 336-337

ui_bugs.component: Viewer recording saved on hangup - no confirmation
ui_bugs.issue: viewer-media-status is rendered only inside the phase==='connected' || demo block. When the user hangs up while recording, the file is saved (web download fires), but the 'Registrazione salvata' or 'Preparo il video registrato…' status and any recError are not visible. The stale message also reappears in the next call. Reference: /app/frontend/app/viewer.tsx:393-416
history-save-contact-<id> is 18x20 px. With hitSlop=8 the effective target is about 34x36, which is below 44x44. Reference: /app/frontend/app/history.tsx:36-38

issues: The contacts-code-input placeholder 'Codice del visore (6 cifre)' is cut off at 375px because of letterSpacing ('...(6 cifr')
contacts-delete-<code> deletes at once with no confirmation or undo
Saving an existing code with a new name silently overwrites the old contact name, with no notice

react_native_issues.issue: src/media.ts imports { File, Paths } from 'expo-file-system', but the package is missing from package.json. It is only resolved transitively through expo@58 (node_modules/expo-file-system 58.0.10). Native builds or autolinking can break if hoisting changes. Reference: /app/frontend/src/media.ts:1, /app/frontend/package.json

action_items: Keep the flood warning visible after the code is regenerated. Option: set a flag in the flood branch, and when the new peer opens, show 'Troppe chiamate in poco tempo: ho creato un nuovo codice. In attesa di chiamata.' instead of the generic text (stage.html:310/336).
Render viewer-media-status outside the connected/demo block, or show it as a toast, so recording-save results after hangup are visible. Clear mediaMsg when a new call starts.
Add expo-file-system explicitly: cd /app/frontend && npx expo install expo-file-system
Minor: raise history-save-contact touch target to 44x44, shorten the contacts code placeholder or reduce its letterSpacing, and consider a confirm step on contact delete and on overwriting a name.
critical_code_review_comments: The stage CSP blocks the Cloudflare insights beacon injected by the preview proxy (console CSP error). This is harmless and does not happen in production WebView.

The flood counter (chiamateRecenti) also counts answered, declined and redialed legitimate calls. Six attempts within 60s, e.g. decline plus redial loops, will rotate the code. That is acceptable, but worth knowing.
Recording picks video/mp4 first when the browser supports it (Chromium does), so files on web are .mp4. On Quest/Android WebView the result may be webm. Both are handled by the ext logic.
